system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 39. 2 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (28 seconds, code score 0.84) ---
[b00] ALEXANDER (deep, steely resolve): "Enough hiding."
[b01] ACTION: Alexander lightly traces the jagged combat scar across his cheek, eyes burning with reclaimed power.
[b02] ALEXANDER (dark, unforgiving): "They buried Alexander Ashwin three years ago."
[b03] ALEXANDER (fierce, commanding): "Today, he comes home."
[b04] ACTION: Alexander emerges in full ducal splendor—dressed in an immaculate navy tailcoat lined with gold embroidery, double-breasted brass buttons, and a crisp white cravat.
[b05] LOYALIST (reverent, submissive): "Your Grace."
[b06] ALEXANDER (authoritative, command): "Secure the chapel."
[b07] LOYALIST (resolute): "Yes, Your Grace."
[b08] ALEXANDER (powerful, roaring defiance): "No more hiding."
[b09] ALEXANDER (fierce, unyielding): "I am taking back my house."

--- WINDOW 1 (37 seconds, code score 0.70) ---
[b00] ROYAL SENTRY (commanding): "Stop!"
[b01] CART DRIVER (meek, deferential): "Firewood for the kitchens, sir."
[b02] ACTION: The driver leaps off the cart, striking the sentry across the chest, seizing his neck, and tackling him violently against the wooden carriage wheel.
[b03] SFX: Dull physical thuds and scuffling boots on wet stone as the guard groans in surprise.
[b04] ACTION: The loyalist locks the sentry into a tight sleeper hold, clamping a hand firmly over his mouth until his eyes roll back and he goes limp.
[b05] LOYALIST FIGHTER (whispering, cold): "Sleep."
[b06] CART DRIVER (relieved, firm): "The road is clear."
[b07] LOYALIST FIGHTER (resolute): "Tell the Duke."
[b08] ACTION: Alexander stares solemnly at his rugged reflection, his expression dark and resolute.
[b09] ACTION: Alexander snips through his overgrown locks, shedding the years of exile and camouflage.
[b10] SFX: Rhythmic, metallic snips of heavy shears cutting through thick hair.
[b11] ALEXANDER (deep, steely resolve): "Enough hiding."
[b12] ACTION: Alexander lightly traces the jagged combat scar across his cheek, eyes burning with reclaimed power.
[b13] ALEXANDER (dark, unforgiving): "They buried Alexander Ashwin three years ago."
[b14] ALEXANDER (fierce, commanding): "Today, he comes home."

Pick the single best promo.
